paragraphs.text: When the discharge rollout slipped I took the blame in front of the clinical directors rather than hand it to my team, and set out a two-week recovery plan. The directors stopped arguing and signed it off.
Halvorsen's health care initiative is the only place where the clinical faculty and the operations faculty teach the same course, which is the gap I keep hitting.
I started the Saturday clinic data club with four analysts and a whiteboard, and it is now how the trust trains its registrars in measurement.
